title: archnm.yaml: the design's name and rules

forbid.description: Patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions) no text may contain: archnm check refuses them. IPs, private keys and API keys are always refused.

description.description: What the group means; shown in the legend.

values.description: The values allowed after the colon.

colors.description: value → #rrggbb, for colouring diagrams by this group.

tags.description: Tag groups: tags written group:value, with the values allowed and their colours.

protect.description: Fields only people change (refs.sys): an agent's apply is refused, and a pull request that changes one says so.

limits.description: A diagram past these is too busy to read; check warns (15 boxes and 20 lines unless set).

github.description: The GitHub owner repo@sha:path sources point at (Acme).
